_note: Diageo = leader mondial spiritueux (Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Guinness, Captain Morgan, Tanqueray, Don Julio). Fiscal year June.

kpis.description_fr: Net Sales Diageo 20.3 Mds£ FY2024. Léger recul après FY23 peak post-COVID. Mix premium élevé, ~50% scotch + reserves.
kpis.description_en: Diageo net sales £20.3B FY2024. Slight decline after FY23 post-COVID peak. High premium mix, ~50% scotch + reserves.

kpis.description_fr: Scotch net sales 5.4 Mds£ FY2024, 27% du CA. Johnnie Walker #1 mondial scotch (>$3B sales). Talisker, Singleton, Lagavulin haut de gamme.
kpis.description_en: Scotch net sales £5.4B FY2024, 27% of revenue. Johnnie Walker #1 global scotch (>$3B). Talisker, Singleton, Lagavulin high-end.

kpis.description_fr: Tequila net sales 2.0 Mds£ FY2024, catégorie croissance la plus rapide. Don Julio et Casamigos drives, premium US.
kpis.description_en: Tequila net sales £2.0B FY2024, fastest growing category. Don Julio and Casamigos drive premium US growth.

kpis.description_fr: Guinness 2.5 Mds£ FY2024. Beer category growth driver, expansion US notable (Guinness 0.0 nitro). Crossover Gen Z.
kpis.description_en: Guinness £2.5B FY2024. Beer category growth driver, notable US expansion (Guinness 0.0 nitro). Gen Z crossover.

kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle 28% FY2024, recul vs FY22 peak. Headwinds Latam + agave costs tequila. Margin structurelle premium.
kpis.description_en: Operating margin 28% FY2024, down from FY22 peak. LATAM headwinds + tequila agave costs. Structural premium margin.

kpis.description_fr: Amérique du Nord 7.5 Mds£ FY2024, plus gros marché 37% CA. Destocking trade post-COVID, attente normalisation FY25.
kpis.description_en: North America £7.5B FY2024, largest market 37% revenue. Post-COVID trade destocking, awaiting FY25 normalization.
